sloka: क्षुधितस्य च सिंहस्य मृग शत्रोः तरस्विनः ।आशी विषस्य वदनात् दम्ष्ट्राम् आदातुम् इच्छसि ॥३-४७-३९॥
transliteration: kṣudhitasya ca siṁhasya mṛga śatroḥ tarasvinaḥ ।āśī viṣasya vadanāt damṣṭrām ādātum icchasi ॥3-47-39॥

translations.english: You are seeking to pull the teeth from the mouth of a hungry and powerful lion who is considered the enemy of the deer(which you are). You intend to pull the fang of a poisonous snake.
